purpose: This table provides cleaned, typed flight-level records for NYC-area departures in 2013, feeding downstream analytics on carrier performance, delays, and routes.
usage: Consumers should treat dep_time, arr_time, dep_delay, arr_delay, and air_time as nullable fields that indicate cancelled or incomplete flight records; filter or handle these nulls deliberately rather than assuming every flight has complete timing data. The declared grain (year, month, day, carrier, flight, sched_dep_time) should be used for joins and uniqueness checks.
limitations: Roughly 3% of rows are missing actual departure and arrival timing data (null_rate 0.029388 to 0.032981), consistent with cancelled or diverted flights, and these gaps were not imputed. tailnum is missing for 0.9% of rows (null_rate 0.009154) and was retained as-is. No exact duplicate rows were found (duplicate_row_rate 0.0), so no row-level dedupe was necessary.
